78805.subject: ⏳ Anthropic puts 10% on AI killing everyone
78805.body:
----------
######           [Subscribe](https://academynews.genai.works/)   -    [Collaborate with us](https://utm.genai.works/r/cq9vsh4)


--------------------
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/8776fa6e-e2d0-4aec-9648-1bed6de3a659/GenAI_Daily_Banner.jpg?t=1778687445)
Caption: 


----------

----------
**Welcome back!** Anthropic's alignment lead put a number on the end of the world after one of the company's researchers quit over it. ChatGPT's unreleased model cracked a 90-year-old math problem that carries a $1 million prize, and the mathematician who got there first says he was pushed aside. Image gen got twice as fast, and Google DeepMind listed every possible mutation in human DNA.

**In today's Generative AI Newsletter:**

* **Anthropic:** What odds does its own safety lead give us?

* **OpenAI:** What did 10,000 agents crack in 88 hours?

* **ChatGPT:** Should designers change careers already?

* **Google:** What scientific milestone did it hit?


----------







----------
## Anthropic's science lead says we could all be dead in 10 years

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/72db807f-55cc-4e19-b39e-cd28fd37b893/Sep_9_-_1.jpg?t=1788944769)
Caption: 

Evan Hubinger runs alignment science at Anthropic. His job is finding the ways the company's safety work fails before a shipped model finds them first. 

[He just put a number on it.](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/09/anthropic-researcher-quits-ai-safety.html) More than a 10% chance AI kills every human in the next decade.

He said Anthropic is trying its best, then added the part that stings. The company has no plan to solve alignment for superintelligence and isn’t on track to get one.

He was backing up Jacob Coxon, who quit Anthropic hours earlier and posted why.

* Coxon spent three years on pretraining research, first at OpenAI, then Anthropic. He says neither company is acting responsibly.

* He said these will soon be superhuman systems that can hack anything and acquire real power, and progress is not slowing.

* Executives soften their words for the press, he says, then express the same fear privately.

* On why they keep building: at OpenAI many haven't internalized the stakes, at Anthropic they understand them but believe someone less careful wins the race if they stop.

Coxon told the Wall Street Journal he's leaving the industry, and that by the end of next year things could already be out of control.

Anthropic sells itself as the careful lab. This week its alignment lead and a pretraining researcher both said the careful lab doesn't have a plan.


----------







----------
## ChatGPT solved a $1 million math problem

78802.subject: Meta Muse bets the AI Agent race against Grok Bot and Gemini will be won on Trust 🤖🛡️; Circle bought Tazapay for…

View this post on the web at https://linas.substack.com/p/fintechpulse1124

Hey Everyone,
Good morning & happy Wednesday! Today, we're diving deep & breaking down Meta's Muse launch to see why the first mass-market AI agent is really a bet that trust, not model quality, wins the agent race against Grok Bot and Gemini (why Meta's trust problem forced the best safety design any consumer agent has shipped, why Muse, Grok Bot and ChatGPT all spend through the same Stripe Link wallet, & what to watch for next + bonus deep dives into the Ultimate Guide to Grok Bot [ https://substack.com/redirect/76aa6e5c-b32d-4ed8-b182-3267f143a700?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], and Anthropic’s Strategy to Win Agentic Commerce [ https://substack.com/redirect/f04e054f-137b-49d5-b0c8-884034e0e08b?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside), and unpacking Circle's $400 million all-stock purchase of Tazapay to see why this M&A is all about the USDC float (why every extra $1B of USDC parked on Circle's own rails is worth more than Tazapay's entire fee line, why the one disclosure Circle hasn't made decides whether this was cheap or expensive, & what to watch after 2027 + bonus deep dives into Coinbase [ https://substack.com/redirect/c3371e7f-8e66-415b-b3ac-f53d183ef941?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], the Ultimate Resources on Stablecoins [ https://substack.com/redirect/9db04b6a-f3b8-4046-8b5f-443866d23dec?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] & 5 Essential M&A Templates [ https://substack.com/redirect/5947864d-d7a5-485c-bb35-6647194dfb70?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside). So let’s just jump straight into the finnovative stuff 🌶️
Meta Muse bets the AI Agent race against Grok Bot and Gemini will be won on Trust 🤖🛡️
The news 🗞️ Just 13 days after agreeing to pay [ https://substack.com/redirect/de546987-f280-473a-95f9-99d7ead6ac68?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]  [ https://substack.com/redirect/de546987-f280-473a-95f9-99d7ead6ac68?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]up to $18 billion to settle state claims that  [ https://substack.com/redirect/de546987-f280-473a-95f9-99d7ead6ac68?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]Instagram and Facebook were built to hook children [ https://substack.com/redirect/de546987-f280-473a-95f9-99d7ead6ac68?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], Meta $META  is now asking American adults to hand its new AI agent their inbox and their credit card.
Muse, launched September 8, is the first personal AI agent with both a mass-market free tier and third-party purchase protection. Meta’s trust deficit forced the most complete consumer safety design any agent has ever shipped, and that design, more than the model, is the whole product.
